name: Tabidachi Study Tours
description: School excursion and study-trip organiser WordPress theme for educational travel agencies, schools, and teachers. Built with an editorial split hero, timed story rails, audience gateway cards, and term-by-term planning timelines. Features clean typography with Source Serif 4 and Nunito Sans, structured itinerary layouts, and calm, accessible design.
